# Right-identity checks for the urban right tooltip search buttons. Root is
# a town_rights_type scope pushed from the GUI (TownRightsType.MakeScope).
cm_trmm_is_search_tooling = {
	is_shown = {
		this = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
	}
}

	is_shown = {
		this = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights

cm_trmm_is_search_any = {
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			this = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
			this = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
		}
	}
}

# Map-tooltip grant row scripted GUIs, one per right. Root is the
# location; cm_country is the clicking player's country.
cm_trmm_grant_tooling = {
	saved_scopes = { cm_country }
	is_shown = {
		exists = owner
		owner = scope:cm_country
		NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights }
		NOT = { integration_level = conquered }
	}
	is_valid = {
		cm_trmm_can_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_tooling_rights }
	}
	effect = {
		cm_trmm_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_tooling_rights }
	}
}

# Right-click grant scripted GUIs: grant plus enable matching
# auto-expands. Each industry registers its chain's base tier; the
# obsolete-registration migration resolves it to the current tier.
# Root is the location; cm_country is the clicking player's country.
cm_trmm_grant_expand_tooling = {
	saved_scopes = { cm_country }
	is_valid = {
		cm_trmm_can_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_tooling_rights }
	}
	effect = {
		cm_trmm_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_tooling_rights }
		building_type:tools_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_grant_expand_jewelry = {
	saved_scopes = { cm_country }
	is_valid = {
		cm_trmm_can_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_jewelry_rights }
	}
	effect = {
		cm_trmm_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_jewelry_rights }
		building_type:jewelry_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_grant_expand_naval = {
	saved_scopes = { cm_country }
	is_valid = {
		cm_trmm_can_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_naval_rights }
	}
	effect = {
		cm_trmm_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_naval_rights }
		building_type:naval_supplies_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { vegetation = woods vegetation = forest vegetation = jungle raw_material ?= goods:lumber } }
			building_type:tar_kiln = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
			cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
		}
	}
}
cm_trmm_grant_expand_textile = {
	saved_scopes = { cm_country }
	is_valid = {
		cm_trmm_can_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_textile_rights }
	}
	effect = {
		cm_trmm_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_textile_rights }
		building_type:cloth_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
		building_type:dyes_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
		building_type:fine_cloth_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
		if = {
			limit = { raw_material ?= goods:dyes }
			cm_enable_auto_expand_for_rgo = yes
		}
	}
}

cm_trmm_grant_expand_masonry = {
	saved_scopes = { cm_country }
	is_valid = {
		cm_trmm_can_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_masonry_rights }
	}
	effect = {
		cm_trmm_grant_right = { RIGHT = royal_masonry_rights }
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_location_market = goods:sand }
			building_type:glass_guild = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
			cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
		}
		building_type:mason = { save_scope_as = cm_building_type }
		cm_enable_auto_expand_for_building_type = yes
	}
